sentences.text:
Between:
Dr.Pasapula Sree Rama Prasanna & another  ...Petitioners/Accused Nos.1 & 2 AND The State of Telangana,
rep. by its Public Prosecutor and others.

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of The Code of Criminal Procedure (for short,
'Cr.P.C) seeking to quash the proceedings against the petitioners/accused Nos.1 & 2 in C.C.No.2424 of 2021, on the file of the learned V Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Cyberabad, L.B.Nagar,
Ranga Reddy District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 323 of IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. Learned petitioners' counsel appeared through online and submitted that the subject matter was settled before Lok Adalat and hence, the Criminal Petition would become infructuous.
3. The 'e'-Courts Case Details information furnished by the Registry pertaining to the subject C.C.No.2424 of 2021 discloses that the said CC ended in compromise before the Trial Court on 02.05.2025 and hence, the cause in the Criminal Petition seeking quash of the said CC does not survive and has become infructuous.
4.
In the result, the Criminal Petition is dismissed as infructuous.
5. Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.

___ JUSTICE TIRUMALA DEVI EADA Date:06.03.2026 ysk THE HON'BLE SMT.
